name: Duality Shift
description:
About This Game

SAVE YOUR WORLD BY RIDING THE LINE BETWEEN PURITY AND CORRUPTION

DUALITY SHIFT is a frenetic FPS Platformer that mixes speedrunning, reality shifting and ultra-dynamic movement, born from a student project at Accademia Italiana Videogiochi.

SWITCH

Shift between the pure world and the corrupted version to unlock hidden paths and phantom platforms, use the electric lines to charge yourself up, run on walls or climb on top of them.

BREAK EVERY RECORD

Every level is a race against time, with medals to unlock and records to break. Are you fast enough to dominate the online leaderboards?

FIND THE TRUTH

Complete levels and progress in the story to uncover the reason behind your misterious powers.
short_desc: Duality Shift is a Singleplayer First Person Racing-Platformer: Run, Jump, perform Parkour moves and completely alter the reality that is around you on your way to the top of the online leaderboards and uncover the secrets of this world along the way.
